receipt-real.json — a receipt this product actually emitted.

HOW TO REGENERATE (the fixture is a capture, never hand-edited):

  repo=$(mktemp -d); home=$(mktemp -d)
  git -C "$repo" init -q -b main
  git -C "$repo" config user.email a@e.invalid; git -C "$repo" config user.name A
  printf 'def rate(w):\n    return 2.5 * w\n' > "$repo/app.py"
  printf 'from app import rate\n\ndef test_rate():\n    assert rate(2) == 5.0\n' > "$repo/test_app.py"
  git -C "$repo" add -A; git -C "$repo" commit -qm first
  S=spec-conformance-fixture
  printf '{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart","session_id":"'$S'","transcript_path":"/t","cwd":"'$repo'","source":"startup"}' \
    | THRULINE_HOME=$home thruline hook claude-code
  printf '{"hook_event_name":"Stop","session_id":"'$S'","transcript_path":"/t","cwd":"'$repo'","last_assistant_message":"All tests pass. I added the rate function and updated the docs.","stop_hook_active":false}' \
    | THRULINE_HOME=$home thruline hook claude-code
  (cd "$repo" && THRULINE_HOME=$home thruline fold >/dev/null)
  (cd "$repo" && THRULINE_HOME=$home thruline receipt --out .../fixtures/receipt-real.json)

WHAT IT EXERCISES that a constructed document does not: the harness/sources
values the CLI actually writes, a real recomputed `event_chain_head` and
`event_count`, a real `policy_hash` (the well-known "no policy file" digest, not
an empty string), a real `git_env_digest`, and both an `unverifiable` and an
`unsupported` verdict from the real verifier — the two the §6 rule is about.

WHAT IT DOES NOT COVER: no `checks` (the session ran no wrapped command), so
`reexecuted`, `container_image_digest` and the `parsed` union are exercised only
by the constructed maximal/minimal documents in spec_conformance.rs. Said here
rather than left to be discovered.

STALENESS: the conformance suite asserts this fixture's `predicateType` equals
`statement::PREDICATE_TYPE` and that it still deserialises into `Statement`. If
either fails, REGENERATE — do not edit the JSON. A hand-patched capture is not a
capture.

that the payload carries no developer home path: the repository was created
under /tmp (subject name `git+/private/tmp/thruline-fixture/repo`) and the
